summary: Lakeshore Acquisition III Corp. filed an 8-K announcing receipt of a $67,500 extension payment from CPRO Electronics (CPRO Korea) under a May 22, 2026 merger agreement, extending the SPAC's deadline to complete its initial business combination by one month to October 1, 2026. No financial terms, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed. This filing reflects routine SPAC extension mechanics rather than a new special-situation event, though it signals ongoing merger progress. Watch for further deadline extensions or merger consummation updates.
